label: TP
reason: The CodeQL alert correctly identifies an XSS vulnerability where user-supplied cookie values ('BenchmarkTest00094' name and 'getValue()' content) are directly concatenated into HTML output via PrintWriter.println() without any sanitization or encoding.

evidence.note: User input from cookies (name/value) flows directly into response writer without encoding.
Sink: response.getWriter().println() concatenates untrusted user data into HTML context.
